nuggets.text: Kyler Murray was the first player drafted in the first round of both the NFL and MLB drafts.
Kyler Murray, in his first season with the Vikings, has already been named a team captain.
Harrison Smith is back for his 15th season, and every one of them has been with the Vikings.
Harrison Smith's cousin is actress Elaine Hendrix, who appeared in the 1998 film The Parent Trap.
Kevin O'Connell won a Super Bowl ring as the Rams' offensive coordinator in Super Bowl LVI.
Kevin O'Connell's father was an FBI agent who played college football at Villanova.
U.S. Bank Stadium's see-through ETFE roof, about 240,000 square feet, is the largest of its kind in North America.
Vikings fans have chanted 'Skol' with the thunder clap since 2016, the year Iceland's soccer fans made the clap famous.
The Vikings have won four of their past five home games against the Packers, dating to 2021.
Kevin O'Connell was named AP NFL Coach of the Year for the 2024 season.
